angleRead.name: Noah Tan
angleRead.text: Three clear days in a row, and the city is finally acting like it. I'm standing at the corner of Grand and Lake Park, coffee going cold, watching people actually sit on the benches instead of hurrying past them. The last stretch was fog, then mild, then a cold clear snap — and now this, a clear day at 58 that feels like the city exhaling. But the record says six people lived through that cold stretch in very different ways. Cee Lee dealt with a seasonal health concern. Johhny Necklar recovered from a winter illness. Elle Lilo finally shook the cold that had been hanging around. Rafael Brannie and Kwame Fitzgerald both pulled back from social life because of winter mood. Omar Amici held tight
